title: Halving Game
statement: In a number game you start with a whole number `n`. Each move: if the number is even, halve it; if it is odd, subtract 1. Return how many moves it takes to reach 0. Write the count recursively: moves(n) is one move plus moves of the next number.

answerKey.pattern: Recursion with one base case and one smaller call
keyPoints: Even n: 1 + moves(n / 2); odd n: 1 + moves(n - 1)
The number at least halves every two moves, so there are O(log n) calls
answerKey.spaceComplexity: O(log n) for the call stack
acceptableSlowerApproaches: A loop that simulates the moves: same time, O(1) space

hints: What is the answer when n is already 0?
After one move, the problem is the same game with a smaller number.
Return 1 + moves(next), where next is n / 2 or n - 1.
